```sql
WITH nebraska_regions AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Nebraska'
    AND border_type = 'state'
),
freeways_in_nebraska AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.geometry
  FROM roads r
  JOIN nebraska_regions nr ON ST_Intersects(r.geometry, nr.geometry)
  WHERE r.highway = 'motorway'
),
longest_freeway AS (
  SELECT id, geometry
  FROM freeways_in_nebraska
  ORDER BY ST_Length(geometry) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
freeway_raster_clip AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(
             r.rast,
             (SELECT geometry FROM longest_freeway)
           ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
        r.rast,
        (SELECT geometry FROM longest_freeway)
      )
),
freeway_slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(clipped_rast, 1) AS slope_rast
  FROM freeway_raster_clip
),
slope_stats AS (
  SELECT ST_Stats(slope_rast, 1, TRUE) AS stats
  FROM freeway_slope
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT region_name FROM nebraska_regions) AS state,
  (SELECT id FROM longest_freeway) AS freeway_id,
  (SELECT ST_Length(geometry) FROM longest_freeway) AS length_meters,
  (SELECT stats.mean FROM slope_stats) AS average_slope_degrees;
```
